text:
sarah-sec: Quick heads-up — SOC team will run a BYOK evidence drill for the EU banking pilot next Tue. Need to confirm RBAC change list + audit log proofs.

dan-sre: ok. which scopes are in play? my understanding: `kms:encrypt/decrypt`, `hsm:import`, admin roles for rewrap and escrow.

mike-crypto: correct. also need to show key origin metadata (HW attestation), creation timestamps, and key-material provenance. auditors will ask for HSM certificate chain.

elaine-legal: we need chain-of-custody docs for customer-owned keys (BYOK) — retention window and access approvals. can you produce an example evidence packet?

sarah-sec: I'll assemble. action items: 1) RBAC delta since last audit, 2) sample audit log slices (create/import/use/revoke), 3) HSM attestation certs, 4) emergency-access play. who picks up which?

dan-sre: I'll grab RBAC diffs and map to IAM policies. will include `allow`/`deny` snapshots and who has ephemeral sudo.

mike-crypto: i'll export attestation and key metadata. note: for privacy we should scrub token ids but keep key IDs + serials. also prepare an example `rekey`/`rewrap` flow with timestamps.

oncall: @sarah-sec FYI — oncall runbook has an ephemeral-breakglass step for HSM ops; we should link it. currently it requires two oncall approvals + sec lead.

sarah-sec: good — i'll include the runbook snippet. also need to validate our audit retention meets the EU bank's 7-year retention ask, or provide a justified exception.

mike-crypto: question re: KMS integration — for customer-managed keys we proxy to an external HSM. auditors often want provable separation: show network boundaries and audit log forwarding (immutable storage). we should include a small diagram.

elaine-legal: include policy text that restricts key export and defines escalation for subpoena/reciprocity. auditors will check we don't have unsanctioned escape hatches.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: `audit/exporter:v1.4.2` -> staging, sha256:abc123.. (automated log-forwarder patch for immutable retention) :white_check_mark:

sarah-sec: excellent. last bit — vuln triage: we had that HSM proxy CVE report last month. auditors will want to know patch state and any compensating controls during the window. dan/mike can you summarise remediation timeline?

dan-sre: CVE-2025-xxxx — mitigation applied 2025-10-08, patch rollout completed 2025-10-12, compensating control: rate-limited admin API + MFA gating. I'll attach the ticket and zk of the rollback tests.

mike-crypto: we also rotated affected keys as precaution on 2025-10-09 and logged rewrap events. logs are in `s3://redwood-audit/evidence/2025/10/rewrap/` (read-only for auditors).

elaine-legal: thanks. can we aim to hand over the evidence packet by EOD Friday? Auditors asked for 48h pre-read.

sarah-sec: yes — i'll collate everything into a zip with a README mapping each artifact to auditor questions. will ping when ready. :thumbsup:

audit-bot: Reminder — evidence submission deadline in 48 hours. Attachments must be checksummed (sha256) and have verifier script.

oncall: will stand by to run the emergency-access test during the drill window.

sarah-sec: great teamwork. we'll keep the thread for any last-minute asks.
